verdict.rationale: GitHub has a well-documented public REST/GraphQL API with fine-grained token permissions (github-docs-18, github-docs-19), plus official CLI and MCP server tooling (github-probe-3, github-probe-4) enabling AI-native driving of the platform. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard endpoints (github-probe-2 shows 404s) and independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness for agentic workflows.
